summary: Install-time beacon to realwbx.com from cover-story styles package
details: The npm package @user-interface-common/common-styles declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs index.js on every install. index.js performs an HTTPS GET to https://realwbx.com/ip.php with a hardcoded Authorization token (bddd640d75c36bd562755a0044764366), notifying the external host of the installer's source IP, install timing, and a static identifier at install time. The package name and scope present it as a UI/styles library, but its description ("This package is for get the IP location and metadata") and shipped code contradict that purpose, and the destination domain is unrelated to any legitimate styles-package publisher. The scope-plus-name shape and install-time beacon to a non-publisher host are consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat install beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
